title: Albany, GA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

Overview

Albany is a city in GA with a population of 75,000. Southwest Georgia hub with the Flint River, Ray Charles Plaza, and agricultural roots. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
